locations.name: San Diego
locations._note: Coords are Pacific Beach — we sleep street-parking here Days 1-2. Per the RV owner's guide: 'In San Diego: park anywhere in the Pacific Beach residential area.' Kept id=san_diego so the route-start label reads as San Diego, but the underlying coords + weather lookup are PB (not downtown SD).

locations.name: Holiday Inn Express Willcox
locations._notes: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Willcox by IHG. 1251 N Virginia Ave, Willcox AZ 85643. I-10 Exit 340, 80 mi east of Tucson. 100 rooms, outdoor heated pool, fitness center, free hot breakfast, free WiFi, free parking. Pet-friendly ($20/pet, 40 lb max). Replaces willcox_walmart as the Day 4 sleep — Willcox sits at 4200 ft so July nights are ~72°F outside (87°F inside an RV); we splurge for AC. Two consecutive hotel nights with Gila Bend (Day 3) is intentional.

locations.name: Willcox AZ
locations._note: On I-10 between Tucson and Lordsburg. Anchor for willcox_hie so it doesn't anchor 66mi off Lordsburg.

locations.name: Holiday Inn Express Deming Mimbres Valley
locations._notes: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Deming Mimbres Valley by IHG. 3801 E Cedar St, Deming NM 88030. I-10 Exit 85. Free hot breakfast, free WiFi, free parking, indoor pool + hot tub. Deming sits at ~4335 ft so July night is ~70°F outside / ~85°F inside RV. Catalog as an alternate hotel on the I-10 corridor between Tucson and Las Cruces (~75 mi straight-line to White Sands). Useful if Day-4 plans shift or we want a hotel closer to WS than Willcox.

locations.name: Hampton Inn & Suites Las Cruces I-10
locations._notes: Hampton Inn & Suites Las Cruces I-10 (Hilton brand). Off I-10 ~2 mi from historic Old Mesilla. Free hot breakfast, free WiFi, free parking, indoor pool. Las Cruces sits at ~3900 ft so July night is ~70°F outside / ~85°F inside RV. Catalog as a hotel option closest to White Sands (~17 mi straight-line) AND closest to the Mesilla restaurant scene (La Posta de Mesilla, Hacienda de Mesilla, etc). Useful if we restructure to do WS the day after a Mesilla dinner.

locations.name: White Sands NP
locations._note: Coords are the WHITE SANDS NP VISITOR CENTER on US-70 (NOT the dunes interior). Per the through-driving rule: we count only the drive to ARRIVE and PARK at the park; Dunes Drive into the gypsum field is sightseeing territory, NOT drive time. Visitor center is at the park entrance off US-70.

locations.name: Sleepy Grass Campground (Lincoln NF)
locations._notes: USFS established campground 1.4 mi S of Cloudcroft on NM-130. 9000 ft elevation, 30 ft RV max, first-come no reservation, $26-$41/night, open May 15 - early Oct. 15 sites. Pavement to entrance; paved/maintained sites. RV-safe for our 24 ft Sprinter. Geographically EAST of White Sands (not closer if approaching from I-10).

locations.name: Manzano Mtns dispersed (Cibola NF FR 542)
locations._notes: Cibola NF Mountainair Ranger District, ~26 mi south of Albuquerque off NM-337/NM-55. ~7200 ft elevation → cool nights (~55°F outside July). Free, no reservation, 14-day stay limit. Big-rig friendly at first pull-offs near the FR 542 entrance per one Dyrt report. Catalog as an alternate for any day where we want a cool free dispersed near ABQ — Day 5 (Cloudcroft → ABQ → Hyde Park) could swap if Hyde Park doesn't work out, or as a Day 4½ rest stop if we add a day.
cautions: Deeper FR 542 sites need 4WD/high-clearance — stay near the entrance. Scout before committing.

locations.name: Three Rivers Petroglyphs
locations._notes: BLM site ~28 mi N of Tularosa, 5 mi off US-54. 21,000+ Jornada Mogollon petroglyphs on basalt ridge, 1-mi loop trail. Gravel BLM lot fits 24' RV. Open dawn-dusk, $5/vehicle. July: go early, brutal sun on exposed rock.

locations.name: Valley of Fires Rec Area
locations._notes: BLM lava field 4 mi W of Carrizozo on US-380. 5,000-yr-old Malpais lava flow, paved 0.75-mi Malpais Nature Trail right off the parking lot. Zero detour from US-380. Large paved lot, easy 24'. Full RV campground on site. Open daily, $5/vehicle. 30-45 min stop.

locations.name: San Antonio NM (Owl Bar / Buckhorn)
locations._notes: Tiny village at US-380 + I-25 exit 139. Owl Bar & Cafe (1945, Manhattan Project lore) and Buckhorn Tavern (beat Bobby Flay) — famous green chile cheeseburger rivalry across the street from each other. Both closed Sundays. Mon-Sat ~11-8:30. Dirt/gravel lot fits 24' RV. Zero detour — right at the I-25 on-ramp.

locations.name: BLM Road 62 Dispersed (Santa Fe NF)
locations._notes: BLM dispersed just off Santa Fe NF, ~7 min west of downtown Santa Fe (https://thedyrt.com/camping/new-mexico/sante-fe-national-forest-blm-road-62). Cattle-guard entrance then immediate left. Sites spread out — open lot near entrance, more secluded pullouts further in. Fits all rig sizes, many flat sites. Pit toilets near entrance. Cell service 3-4 bars AT&T. Daytime shooting / landfill noise reported; quiet at night. Actually slept here on the second night in Santa Fe area (2026-07).

locations.name: Hopewell Lake Campground (Carson NF)
locations._notes: USFS established campground on US-64 between Tres Piedras and Tierra Amarilla. 9500 ft elevation → very cool July nights. Sites fit 18-45 ft. First-come-first-served + some reservable; no gate. Water system out — bring your own. Paved access. Catalog as a paid no-reservation alternate north of Santa Fe en route to Pagosa Springs / Mesa Verde.

locations.name: Tres Piedras dispersed (Carson NF FR 64)
locations._notes: Carson NF FR 64/64G/578 just off US-64 west of Tres Piedras. ~8200 ft elevation → cool nights. 4-5 big-rig spots at the start of the road before 'the Y' — past the Y the road narrows. Free, no reservation, no gate. Catalog as a free dispersed alternate north of Santa Fe en route to Pagosa Springs / Mesa Verde.
cautions: Stay at the first 4-5 sites before 'the Y' — road narrows past that and is not safe for a 24' rig.

locations.name: East Fork FR 667 dispersed (San Juan NF)
locations._notes: San Juan NF FR 667 off US-160, ~10 mi east of Pagosa Springs. ~7800 ft elevation. First 2.7 mi past the East Fork CG entrance has big-rig sites (38' MH confirmed past first bridge). Washboarded but no clearance issues at first sites; 4WD-only marker further in. Free, no reservation, no gate. Catalog as a free dispersed alternate east of Pagosa Springs.
cautions: Stay within the first 2.7 mi past East Fork CG — deeper road is 4WD-only and not safe for a 24' rig.

locations.name: Turkey Springs / Piedra Rd dispersed (San Juan NF)
locations._notes: San Juan NF FR 629/923 off Piedra Rd, ~20 min north of Pagosa Springs. 7500-8000 ft elevation. Smooth gravel/dirt with flat spaces; 40-ft RV access confirmed in the front portion. Free, no reservation, no gate. Some back-area regrowth closures but main area open as of June 2026. Catalog as a STRONG free dispersed alternate near Pagosa Springs.

locations.name: Transfer Park Campground (San Juan NF / Lemon Reservoir)
locations._notes: USFS established campground above Lemon Reservoir, ~14 mi NE of Durango via Florida Rd. ~8100 ft elevation. Upper loop has several larger sites, mostly level. First-come-first-served, no reservation, no gate. $22/night. Catalog as a paid no-reservation alternate near Durango.

locations.name: Mancos
locations._note: On US-160 between Durango and the Mesa Verde NP entrance.

locations.name: Cortez
locations._note: Off-route since 2026-06-30 — through-driving Mancos→Dolores uses CO-184, skipping Cortez. Cortez stays in the catalog as a reference dot but is deactivated.

locations.name: Dolores
locations._note: On CO-145 between Cortez and Telluride.

locations.name: Bayfield-Durango BLM Dispersed
locations._notes: BLM dispersed camping off US-160 between Durango and Bayfield (Google places address 36213 US-160, Bayfield CO 81122 at these coords — right turn on Silver Hills Rd, BLM sign). Big-rig OK, free, no reservation. Used as the Mesa Verde basecamp for Days 8-9.

locations.name: Mesa Verde NP
locations._note: Coords are the MESA VERDE VISITOR & RESEARCH CENTER, which sits RIGHT ON US-160 at the park entrance (NOT down the entrance road into the park, and NOT the Mesa Top Loop or cliff dwellings which are 21+ mi DEEPER into the park down Mesa Top Ruins Rd — those are hiking/sightseeing territory). Coords match Google's geocode of the VRC. Anchored at Mancos because the through-route Mancos→Dolores uses CO-184 and skips Cortez, so Mesa Verde is reached as a south-and-back spur off Mancos along US-160 (not from Dolores by haversine).

locations.name: Madden Peak Rd dispersed (San Juan NF FR 316)
locations._notes: FR 316 off US-160, ~7 mi west of Mancos, ~15 mi to Mesa Verde entrance (~30 min). 20+ dispersed sites, big-rig accessible in the first 1-2 miles before incline. Elevation 7000-9500 ft → cool nights (~50s°F July). Free, no permit, campfires OK, 14-day stay. La Plata Mountain views. Catalog as a CLOSER-TO-MV alternate to mancos_nf for the Day-7 sleep before our Mesa Verde all-day.

locations.name: Last Dollar Rd
locations._note: Deactivated 2026-06-30: road up requires 4wd (RV can't make it). Kept in catalog for reference; itinerary uses Electric Hills Trailhead instead.

locations.name: Electric Hills Trailhead
locations._notes: BLM dispersed at 90 Rd / Electric Hills Trailhead (https://thedyrt.com/camping/colorado/90-rd-dispersed). Gravel switchbacks but accessible to vehicles up to 30 ft per recent reviews. High desert, no facilities. Some road noise possible. Used as a Telluride-area sleep alternative to Last Dollar Rd (which requires 4wd).

locations.name: Black Canyon
locations._note: Coords are the South Rim Visitor Center (the main one). Was (38.5919, -107.7090) — that pulled Google routes onto CO-92 (slow rim road / North Rim approach) when reality is South Rim via CO-347 off US-50. Per through-driving rule: coord should snap to where we'd actually park.

locations.name: Stage Stop Meadows Dispersed
locations._notes: BLM dispersed near Buena Vista, CO (Dyrt: https://thedyrt.com/camping/colorado/stage-stop-meadows-dispersed). Beautiful meadow with mountain views, lots of space, drive-in access — no known vehicle-size restrictions in reviews. Used as Day 11 sleep after Black Canyon + Crested Butte.

locations.name: CR 306 Dispersed
locations._notes: BLM dispersed on CR 306 near Buena Vista, CO (Dyrt: https://thedyrt.com/camping/colorado/cr-306-dispersed). Multiple pullouts of varying quality — some suit big rigs, others tight/steep (reviewer wouldn't pull large trailers into these sites). Highway noise during the day, calms after dark. Sites fill fast on weekends. Alternative option if we want to push further east on Day 11.
cautions: some sites tight/steep for big rigs

locations.name: Marshall Pass dispersed (CR 200 / FR 200)
locations._notes: Off US-285 just south of Poncha Springs, ~15 mi to Salida. Elevation 8,825-10,842 ft along the road. Wide graded dirt, light washboard; 30-ft RVs confirmed. Free, no reservation, no gate. ATV traffic + dust on weekends but quiet weeknights. Catalog as a STRONG cool-night option between Gunnison and Denver on US-285 corridor.

locations.name: Fourmile Creek dispersed (Fourmile TMA, CR 376/375)
locations._notes: BLM/USFS Fourmile Travel Management Area off US-285 north of Buena Vista. ~8,595 ft. Free, FCFS, no gate. ~15 min to Buena Vista, ~30 min to Salida. Graded dirt, washboarded; 30-38 ft rigs reported fine. Heavy ATV weekends. Catalog as a STRONG free dispersed alternate between Salida and Denver on US-285.

locations.name: Turtle Rock (FR 375, Buena Vista)
locations._notes: USFS dispersed area off CR 371, near Fourmile TMA. ~8,267 ft. Free, FCFS, vault toilets, no gate. 24-ft Class C confirmed; 38-ft Class A also fits. Road bumpy/potholed but manageable slow. ATV noise possible. Catalog as a STRONG alternate to fourmile_creek_dispersed in the same area.

locations.name: Kenosha Pass East dispersed (NFSR 126/811)
locations._notes: Pike NF off US-285 at Kenosha Pass. 9,957 ft elevation - very cool July nights. Free, FCFS, no reservation. Designated marked sites only. 27.5-ft RV confirmed. ~1h16m from Denver, ~5 min off US-285. Catalog as a STRONG cool-night option closer to Denver. NOTE: no pets allowed.
cautions: Designated marked sites ONLY — do not freelance. No pets allowed.

locations.name: Redskin Creek / Deer Creek dispersed (Pike NF, Bailey)
locations._notes: Pike NF dispersed north of Bailey CO, off US-285. ~7,500-8,500 ft. Free, FCFS, dirt but well-maintained. RV-friendly per Dyrt. Catalog as a STRONG closer-to-Denver option on US-285 corridor.

locations.name: Monarch Park Campground (FR 231, Monarch Pass)
locations._notes: USFS established campground off US-50 at Monarch Pass. 10,500 ft. 35 sites, fits 45-ft rigs, $24/night. May-July is first-come (Aug/Sep is reservable). No gate. Catalog as a paid no-reservation option near the pass.

locations.name: Tarryall Reservoir SWA / FR 275
locations._notes: Park SWA dispersed off US-285 in South Park. ~8,860 ft. Free, no permit, pit toilets at reservoir. Cattle-gate wire entry (open, not locked). 38-ft motorhomes reported in. AWD recommended after rain. Catalog as a South Park alternate.
cautions: Road gets rough/muddy when wet — check forecast before committing.

locations.name: Buffalo Creek Rec Area dispersed (NFSR 550/552)
locations._notes: Pike NF dispersed south of Bailey. Well-maintained dirt; marked designated sites only (ticket if outside). ~7,500 ft. Free, FCFS. Catalog as a closer-to-Denver option.
cautions: Must use marked designated sites only — not all fit 24'; scout before committing.

locations.name: Sterling Walmart CO
locations._notes: Walmart Supercenter #924, 1510 W Main St, Sterling CO. I-76 Exit 125. Overnight RV parking allowed (semi/RV traffic confirmed). Large flat lot, 24/7 store = no gate close. ~2h15m from Denver — a short first leg eastbound. Phone (970) 522-0600 to courtesy-call.

locations.name: Brush Memorial Park Campground CO
locations._notes: City campground in Brush CO, ~3 mi N of I-76 Exit 90. FCFS no reservation, no gate, electric + water, drop-box ~$25/night. Catalog as a Brighton/Fort Morgan area option (Walmarts there ban overnight).

locations.name: Sterling Rest Area (I-76) CO
locations._notes: Official CDOT rest area on I-76 westbound side near Sterling. Separate RV section, free dump station, 12-hr posted limit (loosely enforced). FCFS, no gate, free.

locations.name: Cabela's Sidney NE
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 59. Free boondock lot in front of store + paid full-hookup sites $20-$45 behind (FCFS). 24' Class C trivially fits. Paved, well-lit, immediately off I-80. Catalog as a utility split between Denver and Lake McConaughy.

locations.name: Flying J Big Springs NE
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 107. Full Pilot/Flying J: RV parking, dump station, showers, restaurant. Overnight allowed, FCFS, 24/7.

locations.name: Ogallala Walmart NE
locations._notes: 201 Pony Express Ln, ~1 mi N of I-80 Exit 126. Dedicated dirt RV/truck lot west of main lot, signed for trucks/RVs. Truck noise but reliable. Different from Lake McConaughy.

locations.name: North Platte Walmart NE
locations._notes: 1401 S Dewey St, ~1.5 mi S of I-80 Exit 177. Confirmed overnight-OK, back of lot, popular with RVs and semis.

locations.name: Cabela's Kearney NE
locations._notes: 3600 US-30, ~1 mi N of I-80 Exit 272. Officially welcomes overnight RVs, 6 marked long-vehicle spaces. Some railroad noise. FCFS, no gate, free.

locations.name: Love's Kearney NE
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 272. Dedicated truck/RV parking (70 spaces), dump station ($10). Backup if Cabela's full.

locations.name: Pilot/Bosselman Travel Center Grand Island NE
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 312 (US-281). Large 24-hr facility, RV parking, dump station, showers, restaurant. FCFS, no gate. Grand Island Walmarts ban overnight.

locations.name: Pilot Wood River NE
locations._notes: 11775 NE-11, I-80 Exit 300. RV parking, showers, laundry, 24/7. Midpoint between Grand Island and Lincoln.

locations.name: Beaver Crossing City Park NE
locations._notes: 3 mi S of I-80 Exit 369. 7 sites with 50A electric + water, FCFS, donation basis (~$10 suggested), 3-night max, no gate. Quiet small-town stop (Lincoln city banned Walmart overnight).

locations.name: Cracker Barrel Lincoln NE
locations._notes: 6700 N 27th St, I-80 Exit 403. Overnight RV-friendly per recent reports; call manager. FCFS, no gate.

locations.name: Cabela's La Vista NE (Omaha area)
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 440, Omaha metro. Designated RV/semi lot behind the store on the west side. Well-lit, spacious, limited road noise, potable water, dog area. Call ahead recommended but not required. 24' Class C fits easily. Free. Catalog as a halfway split between Sidney NE and Des Moines IA.

locations.name: Cracker Barrel Council Bluffs IA
locations._notes: 530 30th Ave, I-29/80 Exit 3. 5-7 marked RV spaces, asphalt, up to 50ft. FCFS, no reservation. Well-lit, low traffic noise. First-night option at NE/IA border.

locations.name: Atlantic Walmart IA
locations._notes: 1905 E 7th St, Atlantic IA. ~10 mi N of I-80 Exit 60. RV-friendly, ample lot. Fills the gap between Council Bluffs and Des Moines.

locations.name: Newton Walmart IA
locations._notes: 300 Iowa Speedway Dr, Newton IA. ~0.5 mi from I-80 Exit 168. Clean lot, semis + RVs nightly, recent positive Class C reports.

locations.name: Grinnell Walmart IA
locations._notes: 415 Industrial Ave, Grinnell IA. ~1 mi from I-80 Exit 182. Well-lit, quiet, restaurants walkable. Splits the gap between Newton and Iowa City.

locations.name: Coralville Walmart IA
locations._notes: 2801 Commerce Dr, Coralville IA. ~1 mi from I-80 Exit 240. Be visible on security cams. Best Iowa City option (Iowa City actual store prohibits).

locations.name: Isle Casino Bettendorf IA
locations._notes: 1777 Isle Pkwy, Bettendorf IA. ~3 mi from I-80 Exit 295B via I-74. Signed RV & Truck lot west of casino, no check-in, multi-night OK, well-lit, security patrols.

locations.name: Cracker Barrel Davenport IA
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 295A, 300 Jason Way Ct. 6 dedicated RV spaces (40 ft long), free, manager-permission norm. Immediately off I-80. Splits a long Des Moines -> South Bend day. Paved, flat, lit. Call ahead day-of.

locations.name: Princeton Walmart IL
locations._notes: 2111 Claude Bailey Pkwy, Princeton IL. ~1 mi from I-80 Exit 56. Generally RV-friendly. (Skip Peru Walmart — explicit no-RV signs.)

locations.name: Morris Walmart IL
locations._notes: 333 E Route 6, Morris IL. ~1 mi from I-80 Exit 112. Reported overnight-friendly right side of lot; park near trucks and stay low-profile.

locations.name: Cracker Barrel Joliet IL
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 127, 1511 Riverboat Center Dr. Six dedicated 44-foot RV/bus spaces on the east side of the lot. Free, FCFS, no gate, no reservation. Manager-permission norm (buy dinner). 2024 reviews confirm overnight tolerated. Splits the Davenport -> South Bend leg in half. Catalog as a Joliet/Chicago-south-bypass utility split.

locations.name: Horseshoe Casino Hammond IN
locations._notes: 777 Casino Center Dr, Hammond IN. ~3 mi from I-80/94 via Cline Ave. Free overnight, well-lit, security. Caveat: only small Class C / Class B fits; 24' is upper end — call (219) 473-7000 ahead.
cautions: 24' is upper-end of what fits — call ahead to confirm before committing.

locations.name: Michigan City Walmart IN
locations._notes: 5780 Franklin St, Michigan City IN. ~1 mi from I-94 Exit 34B (I-80/I-90 toll ~3 mi). Listed as overnight-friendly. Right by Indiana Dunes.

locations.name: Bryan Walmart OH
locations._notes: 1215 S Main St, Bryan OH. ~12 min south of Ohio Turnpike (I-80/90) Exit 13. Large flat lot, low traffic small town, no posted prohibitions in recent reports.

locations.name: Sandusky Walmart OH
locations._notes: 5500 Milan Rd, Sandusky OH. ~5 min from Ohio Turnpike Exit 118. Multiple recent reports of RVs staying multiple nights, quiet, garden-side lot, near Cedar Point exit.

locations.name: Cracker Barrel Macedonia OH (Cleveland metro)
locations._notes: 8160 Macedonia Commons Blvd, Macedonia OH. ~2 min from I-480/SR-8, ~15 min south of I-80/Ohio Turnpike Exit 187. Ample lot, RV-accommodating, positive recent reviews.

locations.name: Cracker Barrel Austintown OH (Youngstown)
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 223, 5600 Interstate Blvd. 9 RV spaces (unusually large for CB), directly off I-80, free, overnight commonly granted. Splits the brutal South Bend -> Allentown leg. Paved, lit, easy in/out. Road noise from I-80.

locations.name: DuBois Walmart PA
locations._notes: 20 Industrial Dr, DuBois PA. ~2 mi / 4 min off I-80 Exit 101. Permission granted when called; staff direct RVs to far end near McDonald's.

locations.name: State College Walmart PA
locations._notes: 373 Benner Pike, State College PA. ~10 min south of I-80 Exit 161 (Bellefonte). Manager-approved overflow upper lot, used by Class C RVs, quiet, safe.

locations.name: Clarion Walmart PA
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 64, 30 Perkins Rd. RV-tolerated per recent RVparky reports; large lot, paved, lit, 0.5 mi off I-80. Right before the heavier PA mountain grades start eastbound. Manager permission expected. Catalog as a western PA alternate.

locations.name: Bailey CO
locations._note: On US-285 between Salida/South Park and Denver. Anchor for redskin_creek_dispersed and other Bailey-area dispersed sites.

locations.name: Hasbrouck Heights NJ
locations._note: Andrew's sister's place. On I-80 just west of NYC, ~30 min from Manhattan. Used as the final Mom + sister visit stop on the last driving day.

locations._note: Off-route 2026-06-23: real I-80 east stays NORTH through Stroudsburg-Parsippany-Hasbrouck Heights. Allentown is south on I-78 — a detour, not on the through-driving line.

locations.name: TA Travel Center Columbia NJ
locations._notes: I-80 Exit 4A in NJ (just over Delaware River from Stroudsburg PA). 172 spaces, RV-friendly. Right on I-80, 24/7, FCFS. (East Stroudsburg Walmart is now NO due to city ordinance.)

locations.name: Pilot Bloomsbury NJ
locations._notes: 979 NJ-173, Bloomsbury NJ. Directly off I-78 Exit 7, ~25 min south of I-80 via I-287 cross. Truck/RV lot, 24/7, free overnight, showers, CAT scale. Closest reliable free overnight to NYC.

locations.name: Cabela's Hamburg PA
locations._notes: 100 Cabela Dr, Hamburg PA. Off I-78 Exit 29B (south of I-80, viable if rerouting via I-78/I-81). Free overnight in marked RV row, free dump station as of 2025, well-lit.
